headline: Red Sox keep rolling in Chicago behind Jake Bennett gem
morning_brew: Five straight wins. I don't wanna jinx it, I don't wanna get ahead of myself, but this team is finally playing the kind of baseball we know they're capable of. Jake Bennett was absolute nails on Wednesday night, holding the White Sox to four hits over seven innings and giving the bullpen a much-needed breather. It's exactly the kind of outing we need while we're waiting on Ranger Suarez to get back in the mix.

The offense did their part too, with Tsung-Che Cheng delivering the multi-RBI performance that gave us some breathing room. When you put up five runs and don't give up a single one, it makes for a stress-free night that I haven't seen in a long time. It feels like this group is finally clicking, and for the first time in a while, I'm actually excited to tune in for the next one at the yard.

Elsewhere, the city is still buzzing about Drake Maye showing up at the Noah Kahan show, and while I love the personality, I'm just ready for the pads to come on in Foxborough. It's a quiet summer for the C's and the B's with the playoff heartbreak still stinging, so I'm putting all my energy into this Sox run. Let's see if they can take the series finale in Chicago before heading into New York.

news_digest.headline: Bennett, Cheng lead the Red Sox past the White Sox, 5-0
news_digest.dans_take: A clean win where everything worked, exactly what we needed to keep the streak alive.

news_digest.headline: Drake Maye makes surprise cameo at Noah Kahan's Boston show
news_digest.dans_take: Good to see our QB out in the city, but let's hope he stays focused on the playbook.
